basic_details.job_title: Nirmithi Kendra, Chamarajanagara Project Manager Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Nirmithi Kendra, Chamarajanagara District, Chamarajanagara, Karnataka, has invited applications for the post of Project Manager under Advt No. ನಿರ್ಮಿತಿ ಕೇಂದ್ರ/ಯೋವ್ಯ/ನೇಮಕಾತಿ/01/206-27. The online application is open from 18 November 2026 to 2 December 2026.

application_fee.all_applicants_fee: Rs. 1,000 (Rupees One Thousand only) per applicant
application_fee.details: Payment mode: Offline only, by depositing the amount into the bank account of Project Manager, Nirmithi Kendra, Chamarajanagara (A/c 110329082601, IFSC CNRB0008183). Last date to pay the fee: 2 December 2026.

age_limit.age_details: Maximum 45 years (as on the date of submission of application)

qualification.education_qualification: M.Tech degree recognised by UGC or AICTE (Full Time / Regular): a regular Bachelors Degree in Civil Engineering/Technology and M.Tech in Structural Engineering/M. Arch Architecture in Regular Mode
qualification.details: Qualification: M.Tech degree recognised by UGC or AICTE (Full Time / Regular). Must be holder of a regular Bachelors Degree in Civil Engineering/Technology and M.Tech in Structural Engineering/M. Arch Architecture Regular Mode Experience: Preference to those who have worked at least 10 years in Government/Semi-Government/Autonomous institutions/Corporations/Boards (as on the date of submission of application) Age limit: Maximum 45 years (as on the date of submission of application) | Other conditions: | Contract duration is 3 years Applications through post or courier will not be accepted | Desirable: | Preference to those who have worked at least 10 years in Government/Semi-Government/Autonomous institutions/Corporations/Boards, as on the date of application

how_to_apply: Apply online only at https://chamrajnagar.nic.in/en/ (online application facility through the SevaOne portal) between 18.11.2026 and 5:00 PM on 02.12.2026.
Deposit the Rs. 1,000 fee offline into Account No. 110329082601, IFSC CNRB0008183, Account Holder: Project Manager, Nirmithi Kendra, Chamarajanagara.
Enter the transaction/reference number and date of payment in the online form and upload the payment receipt/proof of payment.
Submit the application with self-attested documents.
Applications by hand, post or courier are not accepted.
important_instructions: As it is a single post, no reservation is fixed. Recruitment is made as per the Government Secretary, Housing Department letter No. ವಇ244 ಹೆಚ್‌ಎಎಂ 2023 dated 13.10.2026.
